hero.badge: The social publishing hub for every brand you run
hero.subtitle: Upload your media, write your captions, and publish every brand you market, your business, your clients, or yourself, to every social channel from one dashboard. Or hand an API key to your AI agent and let it run the whole thing.

featuresPreview.subtitle: From draft caption to published post, Markaestro handles every step of your social workflow.

items.title: Multi-channel publishing
items.desc: Publish to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and Pinterest from a single composer. Schedule posts or publish instantly.

items.title: Centralized media uploads
items.desc: Bring your own images and videos. Upload once per post and ship to every connected channel.

items.title: Multi-channel previews
items.desc: See how every post will render on each platform before you publish: captions, aspect ratios, character limits.

items.title: Scheduling & calendar
items.desc: Queue posts on a unified calendar with per-channel timing. Reschedule, pause, or duplicate in a click.

items.title: Publishing dashboard
items.desc: Track drafts, scheduled posts, and publish status across every channel.

items.title: OAuth integrations
items.desc: One-click connect to Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and Pinterest via secure OAuth. No manual token management required.

intelligencePreview.subtitle: Intelligence learns from the posts you already published and tells you, in plain language, what worked, when to post, and what to try next. Then it drafts it for you.

items.title: Measured, never guessed
items.desc: Every number is exactly what the platform reported. A blank stays blank, and each result says whether it was measured, calculated, recommended, or generated.

items.title: Patterns with proof
items.desc: Which platform, time slot, hook, or content pillar performs above the rest of your brand, with the sample size and confidence range spelled out.

items.title: Drafts you control
items.desc: Turn any opportunity or winning post into a caption in your brand voice. It lands in Content as a draft. You edit, add media, and schedule.

channelsPreview.subtitle: Connect once and publish to every major platform. Markaestro handles the API differences, character limits, and media requirements for each channel.

channels.name: Facebook & Instagram
channels.desc: OAuth-connected via Meta. Pages, feed posts, stories, and IG business publishing.

channels.name: TikTok
channels.desc: Photo and video posts. Default is a handoff to the creator's TikTok inbox to finish and post; Direct Post to the profile is available per post.

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.desc: Your profile or a Page you manage. Text, image, video, and multi-image posts up to 20 images.

channels.name: Threads & Pinterest
channels.desc: Threads carousels up to 20 items; Pinterest image and video pins to the board you pick.

rows.label: Media
rows.value: Upload images or video: JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4

rows.label: Caption
rows.value: Write once, preview per channel before publishing

rows.label: Output
rows.value: Scheduled or instant posts to all six connected channels

composerPreview.subtitle: Upload the photos or videos you already have. Write the caption you want. Markaestro handles publishing and scheduling so you can stay focused on the creative work.
bullets: Upload images and video directly from your device or library
Channel-aware previews: hashtags, char limits, media specs
Schedule, publish instantly, or save to drafts in one click

agentSection.subtitle: Every paid workspace can mint API keys. Give one to your AI agent and it can discover which accounts it's allowed to post to, upload media, draft and schedule posts, publish them, and report back on what actually shipped, without touching a single platform API itself.
bullets: One key is scoped to one brand. An agent can't wander into another
Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok stay manual-first: a human posts, always
Idempotent writes, async publish runs, and signed webhooks built in

cta.subtitle: Set up in minutes. Connect your channels, upload your media, and start publishing.
